pieces.name: Assembled Outpost
pieces.notes: Complete base: quarters + tunnel + command hub + tunnel + greenhouse.

pieces.name: Command Hub
pieces.notes: Main module and spawn point. Airlock door faces +Z; tunnel ports on +/-X.

pieces.name: Living Quarters
pieces.notes: Rest/sleep module (tiredness recovery). Tunnel port on +X.

pieces.name: Greenhouse
pieces.notes: Enclosed farm module; crops go inside. Tunnel port on -X, side door on +Z.

pieces.name: Connecting Tunnel
pieces.notes: 1.8 m straight tunnel; ends overlap module walls by ~0.15 m.
